generation.generation_method: Built-in image_gen, transparent_background true, brand-new text-only generation

individual_items.label: Painted style
individual_items.evaluation: Rounded child face and broad lavender/aqua paint bands improve simplification; fine curls/scales and softly rendered skin still make this an inclusive refinement priority.

individual_items.label: Face and gaze
individual_items.evaluation: The tilted head and pupils clearly attend to the touching palms. Childlike rounded cheeks, broad eyes and quiet smile read without text.

individual_items.label: Roshan hair/headwear continuity
individual_items.evaluation: New gold tiara and forehead rainbow forelock replace the established Nursery pink headband/cream shell clip and broad trailing rainbow lock; beautiful independent drawing does not preserve the current costume family.

individual_items.label: Nursery apron/blouse continuity
individual_items.evaluation: Aqua apron and lilac gingham remain, but collar, chest star/shell ornaments and lilac moon/stars pocket are replaced by a cream-edged aqua moon pocket. Rebuild the established details before source selection.

individual_items.label: Connected arms
individual_items.evaluation: Both upper arms and low elbows connect visibly to the torso; neither wrist floats. Anatomical proportions are simplified and consistent.

individual_items.label: Palm-rubbing contact
individual_items.evaluation: Near palm lies over a distinct cupped far palm above the basin, with low wrists and finger overlap rather than a raised prayer clasp. This still is not proof of reciprocal motion.

individual_items.label: Contained lather
individual_items.evaluation: Small white foam lies between the palms; none reaches the off tap and no wash outcome is falsely displayed.

individual_items.label: Tail/fin continuity
individual_items.evaluation: Complete curved tail and paired rainbow fin retain identity, but scale colours/order and pale washed fin differ from the current stronger lavender/rainbow family; compare at actual size.

individual_items.label: Basin/tap/pedestal continuity
individual_items.evaluation: Support is clear and usable, but shell-fluted rim/bowl, curved tap and ornate base replace the existing cream-rim basin/cross-handle tap/simple scalloped pedestal.

individual_items.label: Whole-canvas padding/shadow
individual_items.evaluation: Major body and fin silhouettes are present, but shadow reaches left and bottom native limits instead of generous transparent padding. Alpha edge bounds alone do not establish a cropped limb.

individual_items.label: Complete source and family fit
individual_items.evaluation: Useful down-gaze and low reciprocal-contact pose, but costume/hair/fixture continuity remains materially below4.5. Preserve as rejected, unbound source; no current-game score transfer.
